recipes.title: animator_add_parameter
recipes.description: Add a parameter to an existing Animator Controller. Supports float, int, bool, and trigger types with optional default values.

recipes.title: animator_add_state
recipes.description: Add a new state to an Animator Controller layer. Optionally assigns an AnimationClip to the state's motion. The clip is loaded silently — if `clipPath` is provided but the asset is not found, the state is still created without a motion.

recipes.title: animator_add_transition
recipes.description: Add a transition between two existing states in an Animator Controller layer. Both states must already exist; the command returns an error if either is not found.

recipes.title: animator_assign_controller
recipes.description: Assign an Animator Controller to a GameObject. If the GameObject has no Animator component, one is added automatically via Undo. Resolves the GameObject using name, instanceId, or path.

recipes.title: animator_create_controller
recipes.description: Create a new Animator Controller asset.

recipes.title: animator_get_info
recipes.description: Get Animator component information from a GameObject. Resolves by name, instanceId, or path. Returns controller path, speed, root motion, update mode, culling mode, layer count, and parameter count.

recipes.title: animator_get_parameters

recipes.title: animator_list_states

recipes.title: animator_play
recipes.description: Play a specific animation state on an Animator component. Resolves the GameObject using name, instanceId, or path.

recipes.title: camera_align_view_to_object
recipes.description: Align the Scene View camera to look at a specific GameObject. Resolves by name, instanceId, or path.
recipes.signature: CameraAlignViewToObject(string name = null, int instanceId = 0, string path = null)

recipes.title: camera_create
recipes.description: Create a new Game Camera GameObject in the scene. Optionally adds an AudioListener component.
recipes.signature: CameraCreate(string name = "New Camera", float x = 0, float y = 1, float z = -10, bool addAudioListener = false)

recipes.title: camera_get_info
recipes.description: Get the Scene View camera's current position, rotation, pivot, size, and projection mode. Read-only; no parameters required.
recipes.signature: CameraGetInfo()

recipes.title: camera_get_properties
recipes.description: Get all properties of a Game Camera component. Resolves by name, instanceId, or path.
recipes.signature: CameraGetProperties(string name = null, int instanceId = 0, string path = null)

recipes.title: camera_list
recipes.description: List all Camera components in the current scene, ordered by rendering depth. Read-only; no parameters required.
recipes.signature: CameraList()

recipes.title: camera_look_at

recipes.signature: CameraLookAt(float x, float y, float z)

recipes.title: camera_screenshot
recipes.description: Capture a PNG screenshot from a Game Camera to a file. For quick Scene View captures, prefer the native `Unity_Camera_Capture` tool. Use this command when you need a specific Game Camera, custom resolution, or a path under `Assets/`.

recipes.title: camera_set_culling_mask
recipes.description: Set a Game Camera's culling mask using comma-separated layer names. Replaces the entire mask; list all layers that should remain visible.
recipes.signature: CameraSetCullingMask(string layerNames, string name = null, int instanceId = 0, string path = null)

recipes.title: camera_set_orthographic
recipes.description: Switch a Game Camera between orthographic and perspective projection. Optionally set the orthographic size at the same time.
recipes.signature: CameraSetOrthographic(bool orthographic, float? orthographicSize = null, string name = null, int instanceId = 0, string path = null)

recipes.title: camera_set_properties
recipes.description: Set one or more Game Camera properties. Pass only the parameters you want to change; omitted parameters are left unchanged. To change FOV, pass `fieldOfView` — there is no `camera_set_fov` command.

recipes.title: cinemachine_add_component
recipes.description: Add a Cinemachine component to a VCam by type name. Prefer `cinemachine_set_component` when you want to replace the existing Body/Aim/Noise pipeline slot; this recipe just adds a component without removing conflicts at the same stage.

recipes.description: Add a `CinemachineExtension` component to a VCam. If the extension already exists on the VCam, the call succeeds without adding a duplicate.

recipes.description: Configure the Aim stage component (RotationComposer, Composer, PanTilt, POV, etc.) in one call. Only fields matching the active Aim component are applied.

recipes.title: cinemachine_configure_body
recipes.description: Configure the Body stage component (Follow, OrbitalFollow, ThirdPersonFollow, PositionComposer, FramingTransposer, etc.) in one call. Only fields matching the active Body component type are applied.
recipes.signature: CinemachineConfigureBody(string vcamName = null, int instanceId = 0, string path = null, float? offsetX = null, float? offsetY = null, float? offsetZ = null, string bindingMode = null, float? dampingX = null, float? dampingY = null, float? dampingZ = null, string orbitStyle = null, float? radius = null, float? topHeight = null, float? topRadius = null, float? midHeight = null, float? midRadius = null, float? bottomHeight = null, float? bottomRadius = null, float? shoulderX = null, float? shoulderY = null, float? shoulderZ = null, float? verticalArmLength = null, float? cameraSide = null, float? cameraDistance = null, float? screenX = null, float? screenY = null, float? deadZoneWidth = null, float? deadZoneHeight = null)

recipes.description: Configure ClearShot, StateDriven, or Sequencer camera-manager properties in one call. Only the properties whose matching component exists on the target are applied.
recipes.signature: CinemachineConfigureCameraManager(string cameraName = null, int cameraInstanceId = 0, string cameraPath = null, float? activateAfter = null, float? minDuration = null, bool? randomizeChoice = null, string animatorName = null, int? layerIndex = null, string defaultBlendStyle = null, float? defaultBlendTime = null, bool? loop = null)

recipes.title: cinemachine_configure_extension
recipes.description: Configure a Cinemachine extension (`CinemachineConfiner`, `CinemachineDeoccluder`/`CinemachineCollider`, `CinemachineFollowZoom`, `CinemachineGroupFraming`, etc.). If `extensionName` is omitted, the first extension found on the VCam is used.
recipes.signature: CinemachineConfigureExtension(string vcamName = null, int instanceId = 0, string path = null, string extensionName = null, string boundingShapeName = null, float? damping = null, float? slowingDistance = null, float? cameraRadius = null, string strategy = null, int? maximumEffort = null, float? smoothingTime = null, float? width = null, float? fovMin = null, float? fovMax = null, string framingMode = null, float? framingSize = null, string sizeAdjustment = null)

recipes.title: cinemachine_configure_impulse_source
recipes.description: Configure a `CinemachineImpulseSource` definition: amplitude gain, frequency gain, impact radius, signal duration, and dissipation rate. If no source is specified, the first source found in the scene is used.
recipes.signature: CinemachineConfigureImpulseSource(string sourceName = null, int sourceInstanceId = 0, string sourcePath = null, float? amplitudeGain = null, float? frequencyGain = null, float? impactRadius = null, float? duration = null, float? dissipationRate = null)

recipes.title: cinemachine_create_clear_shot
